name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v5.97: machine list redesigned for find-and-tap on mobile. Search box promoted to the top; the list is now tappable machine cards (status dot, name, error badge, device id, location, last-restocked, today revenue) instead of a wide table; locations map and revenue overview demoted to a collapsible section. Added a sort toggle (restock age / errors / revenue). Backend adds openAlertCount per machine on the list endpoint (count of unresolved warning+critical alerts, grouped by device) to drive the error badge and the errors sort. Cumulative over v5.96.
